question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over China's Communist Party and state institutions ahead of the 2027 Party Congress, with ongoing military and elite purges reinforcing loyalty to his leadership rather than signaling instability. His active role in early 2026 diplomacy, New Year planning for the 15th Five-Year Plan, and prioritization of national security alongside technological self-reliance reflect sustained authority following the removal of term limits and elevation of his ideological framework. Trader consensus at 95.5% against removal before 2027 aligns with the absence of credible succession signals or factional challenges, consistent with historical patterns of centralized power under his tenure. While health events, sudden elite fractures, or external shocks could theoretically shift dynamics, current institutional consolidation and lack of visible alternatives support expectations of continuity through the current term.
